scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: A person driving a motor vehicle on the road.
A person riding a bicycle on the road.

A person walking, a person traveling on something other than a vehicle or bicycle (such as roller skates or a skateboard), or a person with a disability using a tricycle, quadricycle or wheelchair for transportation.
Any place where one road meets another road.
An INTERSECTION where one road ends at a through road that continues straight.
A wide white line that shows drivers where to stop before an INTERSECTION or CROSSWALK.
The part of the road set aside for pedestrians to cross, marked or unmarked.
A lane in the middle of a two-way street, marked on each side by a broken inner line and a solid outer line, used to prepare for and make left turns or U-turns.
A right turn lane that does not merge into another lane and allows a right turn without stopping.
Turning the vehicle around to go back in the direction it came from.
A lane for bicyclists only running alongside vehicle traffic, typically marked by a single solid white line and signs, sometimes painted green.
A lane or area designated by posted signs for public transit bus use only.
Two sets of solid double yellow lines spaced two or more feet apart.
The part of a city or town where most offices and businesses are.
An intersection where traffic travels in one direction around a central island.
A rail vehicle such as a light rail train or streetcar running on tracks on public roads.
To wait for, slow down, and be ready to stop if necessary to allow other road users who have the RIGHT-OF-WAY to proceed.
The rules that determine who is allowed to go first when vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists meet on the road.
An area around the vehicle that the driver cannot see when looking straight ahead or using the mirrors, usually at the sides slightly behind the driver.
Steering by starting with hands at 8 and 4 o'clock, reaching across the wheel to grasp the opposite side, releasing the other hand, then reaching across the holding arm to grip and pull up.
Push/pull steering with hands kept at 9 and 3 or 8 and 4 o'clock without crossing over the middle of the wheel.

rules.title: Always signal a turn
rules.when: preparing to turn
rules.action: signal the turn, even when no other vehicles are seen nearby
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn, the DRIVER MUST signal the turn, even when no other vehicles are seen nearby.
rules.note: 9.28 is a plain command ('Always signal'); 9.38 adds that the signal should be given even when no other vehicles are seen.

rules.title: Signal 100 feet before turning
rules.when: preparing to turn
rules.action: start signaling at least 100 feet before the turn
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn, the DRIVER MUST start signaling at least 100 feet before the turn.
rules.note: 9.33-9.34 say 'should signal at least 100 feet'; 10.93 says 'about 100 feet' for right turns; 10.115 is a plain command for left turns. The stronger instruction is recorded.

rules.title: Turn just beyond an intersection
rules.when: the DRIVER plans to turn shortly after crossing an INTERSECTION
rules.action: signal when almost through the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER plans to turn shortly after crossing an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER SHOULD signal when almost through the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Cancel the turn signal
rules.when: the turn signal is no longer needed
rules.action: turn off the turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN the turn signal is no longer needed, the DRIVER MUST turn off the turn signal.

rules.title: Hand-and-arm turn signals
rules.when: turning AND the vehicle's signal lights are not functioning OR bright sunlight makes the signal lights hard to see
rules.action: signal with hand-and-arm positions: the left arm extended straight out for a left turn, the left arm bent upward at the elbow for a right turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning AND the vehicle's signal lights are not functioning OR bright sunlight makes the signal lights hard to see, the DRIVER MUST signal with hand-and-arm positions: the left arm extended straight out for a left turn, the left arm bent upward at the elbow for a right turn.
rules.note: The arm positions are shown only in the images under the LEFT TURN and RIGHT TURN headings.

rules.title: Cyclist turn signal
rules.when: planning to turn
rules.action: signal the turn with an arm held straight out, pointing in the direction of the turn
rules.statement: WHEN planning to turn, the CYCLIST MAY signal the turn with an arm held straight out, pointing in the direction of the turn.

rules.title: Position at right edge
rules.when: preparing to make a right turn
rules.action: drive close to the right edge of the road
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to make a right turn, the DRIVER MUST drive close to the right edge of the road.

rules.title: Enter right turn lane at opening
rules.when: preparing to make a right turn AND a designated right turn lane is available
rules.action: enter the right turn lane at its opening
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to make a right turn AND a designated right turn lane is available, the DRIVER MUST enter the right turn lane at its opening.

rules.title: Watch users beside you when turning right
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: watch for PEDESTRIANS crossing the street and for CYCLISTS and motorcyclists between the vehicle and the curb or riding next to the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST watch for PEDESTRIANS crossing the street and for CYCLISTS and motorcyclists between the vehicle and the curb or riding next to the vehicle.
rules.note: Stated in the right-turn steps, the turn examples and the right-of-way rules.

rules.title: Shoulder check and slow for right turn
rules.when: approaching a right turn
rules.action: look over the right shoulder and reduce speed
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a right turn, the DRIVER MUST look over the right shoulder and reduce speed.

rules.title: Stop position before right turn
rules.when: making a right turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: stop behind the LIMIT LINE, or before entering the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before entering the INTERSECTION if there is no CROSSWALK
rules.unless: turning from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE with no traffic light or sign requiring a stop
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST stop behind the LIMIT LINE, or before entering the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before entering the INTERSECTION if there is no CROSSWALK, UNLESS turning from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE with no traffic light or sign requiring a stop.
rules.note: The exception is taken from 10.105, which allows turns from a dedicated right turn lane without stopping.

rules.title: Look left-right-left before turning right
rules.when: about to make a right turn
rules.action: look left, right and left again and turn only when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a right turn, the DRIVER MUST look left, right and left again and turn only when it is safe.

rules.title: No wide right turns
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: begin and end the turn in the lane closest to the right edge of the road without turning wide into another lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST begin and end the turn in the lane closest to the right edge of the road without turning wide into another lane.
rules.note: Diagrams show the right-turning car staying in the nearest right lane.

rules.title: Right turn one-way to one-way: start lane
rules.when: making a right turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street
rules.action: start the turn in the far-right lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street, the DRIVER MUST start the turn in the far-right lane.

rules.title: Right turn one-way to one-way: end lane
rules.when: making a right turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street AND it is safe
rules.action: end the turn in any lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street AND it is safe, the DRIVER MAY end the turn in any lane.
rules.note: The diagram shows the car ending in any of the lanes of the one-way street.

rules.title: Crossing a bus lane to turn right
rules.when: making a right turn AND a PUBLIC TRANSIT BUS LANE lies between the vehicle and the turn
rules.action: cross the PUBLIC TRANSIT BUS LANE to make the turn
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn AND a PUBLIC TRANSIT BUS LANE lies between the vehicle and the turn, the DRIVER MAY cross the PUBLIC TRANSIT BUS LANE to make the turn.
rules.note: Otherwise it is illegal to drive, stop, park or leave a vehicle in an area designated for public transit buses.

rules.title: Dedicated right turn lane: no stop needed
rules.when: turning right from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE
rules.action: make the turn without stopping, even if the light for vehicles going straight through the INTERSECTION is red
rules.unless: a traffic light or sign on the right curb of the DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE requires otherwise
rules.statement: WHEN turning right from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MAY make the turn without stopping, even if the light for vehicles going straight through the INTERSECTION is red, UNLESS a traffic light or sign on the right curb of the DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE requires otherwise.

rules.title: Dedicated right turn lane: obey curb signal or sign
rules.when: turning right from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE AND there is a traffic light or sign on the right curb of that lane
rules.action: obey that light or sign
rules.statement: WHEN turning right from a DEDICATED RIGHT TURN LANE AND there is a traffic light or sign on the right curb of that lane, the DRIVER MUST obey that light or sign.

rules.title: Position for left turn
rules.when: preparing to make a left turn
rules.action: drive close to the center divider or into the left turn lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to make a left turn, the DRIVER MUST drive close to the center divider or into the left turn lane.
rules.note: 10.33 also advises using the left lane to turn left.

rules.title: Enter left turn lane at opening
rules.when: entering a designated left turn lane
rules.action: enter at the opening without crossing any solid line
rules.statement: WHEN entering a designated left turn lane, the DRIVER MUST enter at the opening without crossing any solid line.

rules.title: Shoulder check and slow for left turn
rules.when: approaching a left turn
rules.action: look over the left shoulder and reduce speed
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a left turn, the DRIVER MUST look over the left shoulder and reduce speed.

rules.title: Stop position before left turn
rules.when: making a left turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: stop behind the LIMIT LINE, or before entering the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before entering the INTERSECTION if there is no CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST stop behind the LIMIT LINE, or before entering the CROSSWALK if there is no LIMIT LINE, or before entering the INTERSECTION if there is no CROSSWALK.
rules.note: Listed as a step of every left turn; signals such as a green arrow may allow proceeding without a stop (see TURN-SIGNL rules).

rules.title: Look left-right-left before turning left
rules.when: about to make a left turn
rules.action: look left, right and left again and begin the turn only when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a left turn, the DRIVER MUST look left, right and left again and begin the turn only when it is safe.

rules.title: Complete left turn in left lane
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: proceed into the INTERSECTION while turning and complete the turn in the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the DRIVER MUST proceed into the INTERSECTION while turning and complete the turn in the left lane.

rules.title: Wheels straight while waiting
rules.when: waiting to make a left turn
rules.action: keep the wheels pointed straight ahead and not turn the steering wheel until it is safe to start the turn
rules.statement: WHEN waiting to make a left turn, the DRIVER MUST keep the wheels pointed straight ahead and not turn the steering wheel until it is safe to start the turn.
rules.note: Reason given: if the wheels point left and the vehicle is hit from behind, it could be pushed into oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Smooth acceleration out of left turn
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: accelerate smoothly during and after the turn and allow the steering wheel to straighten in the new lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the DRIVER MUST accelerate smoothly during and after the turn and allow the steering wheel to straighten in the new lane.

rules.title: Left turn from a two-way street onto a two-way street
rules.when: making a left turn from a two-way street onto a two-way street
rules.action: start the turn in the left lane closest to the middle of the street and end it in the left lane closest to the middle of the street going in the vehicle's direction
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn from a two-way street onto a two-way street, the DRIVER MUST start the turn in the left lane closest to the middle of the street and end it in the left lane closest to the middle of the street going in the vehicle's direction.
rules.note: Reason given: to reduce the risk of collision.

rules.title: Left turn from a two-way onto a one-way street: start lane
rules.when: making a left turn from a two-way street onto a one-way street
rules.action: start the turn from the lane closest to the middle of the street
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn from a two-way street onto a one-way street, the DRIVER MUST start the turn from the lane closest to the middle of the street.

rules.title: Left turn onto a multi-lane one-way street: end lane
rules.when: making a left turn onto a one-way street AND there are three or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction of travel
rules.action: end the turn in any lane that is open
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn onto a one-way street AND there are three or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction of travel, the DRIVER MAY end the turn in any lane that is open.
rules.note: Stated for left turns onto a one-way street from both a two-way street and a one-way street.

rules.title: Left turn from a one-way onto a two-way street
rules.when: making a left turn from a one-way street onto a two-way street
rules.action: start the turn from the far-left lane and end it in the left lane closest to the middle of the street going in the vehicle's direction
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn from a one-way street onto a two-way street, the DRIVER MUST start the turn from the far-left lane and end it in the left lane closest to the middle of the street going in the vehicle's direction.
rules.note: Reason given: to reduce the risk of collision.

rules.title: Left turn from a one-way onto a one-way street: start lane
rules.when: making a left turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street
rules.action: start the turn from the far-left lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street, the DRIVER MUST start the turn from the far-left lane.

rules.title: T intersection from a one-way street: center lane
rules.when: turning at a T INTERSECTION from a one-way street onto a two-way street
rules.action: turn either right or left from the center lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning at a T INTERSECTION from a one-way street onto a two-way street, the DRIVER MAY turn either right or left from the center lane.
rules.note: The diagram shows the center-lane car turning either way while the left lane turns left and the right lane turns right.

rules.title: Oncoming right signal is not a guarantee
rules.when: turning left AND an oncoming vehicle has its right turn signal on
rules.action: wait for the oncoming vehicle to start its turn before beginning the left turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning left AND an oncoming vehicle has its right turn signal on, the DRIVER MUST wait for the oncoming vehicle to start its turn before beginning the left turn.
rules.note: Reason given: the other driver may have signaled by mistake or plan to turn just beyond.

rules.title: Center left turn lane only for turning
rules.when: driving in a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.action: use the lane to prepare for and make a left turn or a U-TURN, not as a regular traffic lane or passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN driving in a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MAY ONLY use the lane to prepare for and make a left turn or a U-TURN, not as a regular traffic lane or passing lane.
rules.note: Force is INSTRUCTION ('Use the center left turn lane to...; it is not a regular traffic lane'); MAY ONLY expresses the restriction. Strictly the force table allows MUST/MUST NOT for INSTRUCTION; read as 'MUST NOT use it for anything else'.

rules.title: 200 feet maximum in center left turn lane
rules.when: using a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.action: drive in the lane for at most 200 feet, entering it within 200 feet of the turn
rules.statement: WHEN using a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive in the lane for at most 200 feet, entering it within 200 feet of the turn.

rules.title: Look for oncoming users in center lane
rules.when: preparing to turn left from a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.action: look for other vehicles coming toward the DRIVER in the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn left from a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST look for other vehicles coming toward the DRIVER in the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE.

rules.title: Signal and check blind spots before entering center lane
rules.when: moving into a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to turn left
rules.action: signal and look over the shoulder to check the BLIND SPOTS
rules.statement: WHEN moving into a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to turn left, the DRIVER MUST signal and look over the shoulder to check the BLIND SPOTS.

rules.title: Merge completely into center lane
rules.when: entering a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to turn left
rules.action: merge completely into the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE so as not to block traffic, then turn when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN entering a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to turn left, the DRIVER MUST merge completely into the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE so as not to block traffic, then turn when it is safe.

rules.title: Respect users already in center lane
rules.when: entering a two-way CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.action: respect the RIGHT-OF-WAY of any vehicle, CYCLIST or motorcyclist already in the lane and YIELD to PEDESTRIANS
rules.statement: WHEN entering a two-way CENTER LEFT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST respect the RIGHT-OF-WAY of any vehicle, CYCLIST or motorcyclist already in the lane and YIELD to PEDESTRIANS.

rules.title: Left across double yellow to a driveway
rules.when: turning left to enter or exit a driveway or private road AND there is a single set of double solid yellow lines
rules.action: cross the double yellow lines to make the turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning left to enter or exit a driveway or private road AND there is a single set of double solid yellow lines, the DRIVER MAY cross the double yellow lines to make the turn.
rules.note: Exception to the instruction not to pass over double solid yellow lines.

rules.title: No turns across a barrier
rules.when: there is a BARRIER beside the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: make a left turn or a U-TURN across the BARRIER
rules.unless: there is a designated opening in the BARRIER
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BARRIER beside the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a left turn or a U-TURN across the BARRIER, UNLESS there is a designated opening in the BARRIER.
rules.note: 10.135 repeats the U-turn prohibition for two sets of double yellow lines on a divided highway.

rules.title: Follow through on a turn
rules.when: the DRIVER has started to make a turn
rules.action: follow through and complete the turn
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has started to make a turn, the DRIVER MUST follow through and complete the turn.
rules.note: Reason given: last minute direction changes may increase the risk of collisions.

rules.title: Missed turn
rules.when: the DRIVER misses a turn
rules.action: keep driving until the DRIVER can safely and legally turn around
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER misses a turn, the DRIVER MUST keep driving until the DRIVER can safely and legally turn around.

rules.title: Check blind spots before turning
rules.when: about to turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: check the BLIND SPOTS by looking over the right and left shoulders, turning only the head
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST check the BLIND SPOTS by looking over the right and left shoulders, turning only the head.

rules.title: Check behind before turning into side road
rules.when: turning into a side road or driveway
rules.action: check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, side mirrors and by turning the head
rules.statement: WHEN turning into a side road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, side mirrors and by turning the head.
rules.note: Reason given: to avoid rear-end collisions.

rules.title: Hand-over-hand steering for low-speed turns
rules.when: turning at low speeds
rules.action: use HAND-OVER-HAND STEERING
rules.statement: WHEN turning at low speeds, the DRIVER MUST use HAND-OVER-HAND STEERING.

rules.title: Hand-to-hand steering through turns
rules.when: using HAND-TO-HAND STEERING AND making a turn
rules.action: keep the hands at 9 and 3 o'clock or 8 and 4 o'clock without crossing them over the middle of the steering wheel
rules.statement: WHEN using HAND-TO-HAND STEERING AND making a turn, the DRIVER MUST keep the hands at 9 and 3 o'clock or 8 and 4 o'clock without crossing them over the middle of the steering wheel.

rules.title: One hand at 12 o'clock when turning while backing
rules.when: turning while backing up AND steering with one hand to see behind
rules.action: place the steering hand at the 12 o'clock position on the steering wheel
rules.statement: WHEN turning while backing up AND steering with one hand to see behind, the DRIVER MUST place the steering hand at the 12 o'clock position on the steering wheel.

rules.title: No fast turns on slippery surfaces
rules.when: driving on ice, packed snow or another slippery surface
rules.action: make fast turns
rules.statement: WHEN driving on ice, packed snow or another slippery surface, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT make fast turns.
rules.note: Reason given: to prevent skidding.

rules.title: Slow down when changing direction in wet conditions
rules.when: driving in wet or rainy conditions AND changing direction
rules.action: slow down
rules.statement: WHEN driving in wet or rainy conditions AND changing direction, the DRIVER MUST slow down.
rules.note: Given as a step to avoid hydroplaning.

rules.title: Right turn on red
rules.when: facing a solid red light
rules.action: turn right after making a complete stop at the stop or LIMIT LINE, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and turning when it is safe
rules.unless: a 'No Turn on Red' sign is posted
rules.statement: WHEN facing a solid red light, the DRIVER MAY turn right after making a complete stop at the stop or LIMIT LINE, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and turning when it is safe, UNLESS a 'No Turn on Red' sign is posted.
rules.note: Stated in the turn section and the traffic signal section; 10.99 adds that the normal right-turn steps apply.

rules.title: No turn on a red arrow
rules.when: facing a red arrow
rules.action: turn, and must remain stopped until a green light or green arrow appears
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red arrow, the DRIVER MUST NOT turn, and must remain stopped until a green light or green arrow appears.
rules.note: 10.101 says 'may not turn right'; 12.11 says 'Do not turn at a red arrow'.

rules.title: Left turn on red, one-way to one-way
rules.when: facing a red light AND turning from a one-way street onto a one-way street
rules.action: turn left after stopping, yielding to vehicles, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS who have a green light, looking both ways and turning when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light AND turning from a one-way street onto a one-way street, the DRIVER MAY turn left after stopping, yielding to vehicles, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS who have a green light, looking both ways and turning when it is safe, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: The need to stop first is inferred from 12.6 (a red light means STOP); 10.125 does not repeat it.

rules.title: Yellow arrow
rules.when: facing a yellow arrow AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely OR is already in the INTERSECTION
rules.action: cautiously complete the turn and pay attention to the next signal
rules.statement: WHEN facing a yellow arrow AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely OR is already in the INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST cautiously complete the turn and pay attention to the next signal.
rules.note: A yellow arrow means the protected turning time is ending; the next signal may be a green or red light or a red arrow.

rules.title: Flashing yellow arrow
rules.when: facing a flashing yellow arrow
rules.action: turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic, proceeding with caution
rules.statement: WHEN facing a flashing yellow arrow, the DRIVER MAY turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic, proceeding with caution.
rules.note: The turn is not protected from other traffic.

rules.title: Green arrow: protected turn
rules.when: facing a green arrow
rules.action: make a protected turn in the direction the arrow points
rules.statement: WHEN facing a green arrow, the DRIVER MAY make a protected turn in the direction the arrow points.
rules.note: Oncoming vehicles are stopped by a red light.

rules.title: Turn prohibition signs
rules.when: a regulatory sign prohibits a turn, such as 'No Left Turn', 'No Right Turn', 'No Turns' or a red circle with a red line through a turn arrow
rules.action: make the prohibited turn
rules.statement: WHEN a regulatory sign prohibits a turn, such as 'No Left Turn', 'No Right Turn', 'No Turns' or a red circle with a red line through a turn arrow, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the prohibited turn.
rules.note: The signs are shown in the sign chart; 12.73 explains that the picture inside the red circle shows what you cannot do.

rules.title: Turn-only lane sign
rules.when: a white regulatory sign shows a turn arrow with the word 'ONLY' for the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: turn in the direction of the arrow
rules.statement: WHEN a white regulatory sign shows a turn arrow with the word 'ONLY' for the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST turn in the direction of the arrow.
rules.note: Rests on the sign chart alone, which shows a left-turn arrow 'ONLY' sign among white regulatory signs; 12.85 says white rectangular signs state rules you must obey.

rules.title: Multiple turn lanes
rules.when: signs or arrows indicate that a turn can be made from or end in more than one lane
rules.action: turn from or end the turn in any of the indicated lanes
rules.statement: WHEN signs or arrows indicate that a turn can be made from or end in more than one lane, the DRIVER MAY turn from or end the turn in any of the indicated lanes.

rules.title: Left turn yield on green sign
rules.when: turning left on a solid green light AND a 'Left Turn Yield on Green' sign is posted
rules.action: YIELD to oncoming traffic before turning
rules.statement: WHEN turning left on a solid green light AND a 'Left Turn Yield on Green' sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST YIELD to oncoming traffic before turning.
rules.note: Rests on the sign chart, which shows the 'LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN' sign among white regulatory signs.

rules.title: How to make a U-turn
rules.when: making a U-TURN
rules.action: signal and use the left turn lane or far-left lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST signal and use the left turn lane or far-left lane.

rules.title: U-turn across a double yellow line
rules.when: there is a single set of double yellow lines
rules.action: make a U-TURN across the double yellow lines
rules.statement: WHEN there is a single set of double yellow lines, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN across the double yellow lines.
rules.note: The image shows a car making a U-turn where the double yellow lines end, with 'END DIVIDED ROAD' and 'U-TURN OK' signs. Two sets of double yellow lines may not be crossed (TURN-MARK-02).

rules.title: U-turn in a residential district
rules.when: in a residential district AND no vehicles are approaching within 200 feet
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN in a residential district AND no vehicles are approaching within 200 feet, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN.

rules.title: U-turn at an intersection on green
rules.when: at an INTERSECTION AND facing a green light or green arrow
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN at an INTERSECTION AND facing a green light or green arrow, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN, UNLESS a 'No U-Turn' sign is posted.

rules.title: U-turn at a divider opening
rules.when: on a divided highway AND a center divider opening is provided
rules.action: make a U-TURN through the opening
rules.statement: WHEN on a divided highway AND a center divider opening is provided, the DRIVER MAY make a U-TURN through the opening.

rules.title: No U-turn sign
rules.when: a 'No U-Turn' sign is posted
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN a 'No U-Turn' sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: The sign is a red circle with a red line through a U-turn arrow; regulatory sign, and 10.133 says 'Never'.

rules.title: No U-turn at a railroad crossing
rules.when: at or on a railroad crossing
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN at or on a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn across a highway divider
rules.when: on a divided highway
rules.action: make a U-TURN by crossing a dividing section, curb, strip of land or two sets of double yellow lines
rules.statement: WHEN on a divided highway, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN by crossing a dividing section, curb, strip of land or two sets of double yellow lines.

rules.title: No U-turn without 200 feet of view
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot see clearly for 200 feet in each direction
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot see clearly for 200 feet in each direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn on a one-way street
rules.when: on a one-way street
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on a one-way street, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn at a fire station
rules.when: in front of a fire station
rules.action: make a U-TURN or use the fire station driveway to turn around
rules.statement: WHEN in front of a fire station, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN or use the fire station driveway to turn around.

rules.title: No U-turn in a business district
rules.when: in a BUSINESS DISTRICT
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.unless: the DRIVER is at an INTERSECTION OR on a divided highway where an opening has been provided
rules.statement: WHEN in a BUSINESS DISTRICT, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN, UNLESS the DRIVER is at an INTERSECTION OR on a divided highway where an opening has been provided.

rules.title: Turn around when going the wrong way
rules.when: the DRIVER has entered a roadway against traffic, shown by DO NOT ENTER or WRONG WAY signs or by road reflectors shining red in the headlights at night
rules.action: back out or turn around when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has entered a roadway against traffic, shown by DO NOT ENTER or WRONG WAY signs or by road reflectors shining red in the headlights at night, the DRIVER MUST back out or turn around when it is safe.
rules.note: DO NOT ENTER and WRONG WAY are sign legends, not defined terms.

rules.title: Yield to pedestrians when turning
rules.when: turning
rules.action: YIELD to PEDESTRIANS in a CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN turning, the DRIVER MUST YIELD to PEDESTRIANS in a CROSSWALK.
rules.note: 10.105 says 'Always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk when turning'; 10.114 says 'Always yield to pedestrians'; 12.94 says pedestrians always have the right-of-way.

rules.title: Left turn: yield to dangerous approaching traffic
rules.when: turning left at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: check for PEDESTRIANS and give the RIGHT-OF-WAY to any PEDESTRIAN or approaching vehicle that is close enough to be dangerous
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST check for PEDESTRIANS and give the RIGHT-OF-WAY to any PEDESTRIAN or approaching vehicle that is close enough to be dangerous.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.title: T intersection: through traffic first
rules.when: turning from the ending road at a T INTERSECTION without STOP or YIELD signs
rules.action: YIELD to vehicles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS on the through road
rules.statement: WHEN turning from the ending road at a T INTERSECTION without STOP or YIELD signs, the DRIVER MUST YIELD to vehicles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS on the through road.
rules.note: Through traffic has the right-of-way (12.96, 10.154); 12.92 says others must wait for the person who has the right-of-way. STOP and YIELD here are sign legends.

rules.title: Care with blind pedestrians when turning
rules.when: turning AND a PEDESTRIAN using a guide dog or white cane is nearby
rules.action: be careful and give the PEDESTRIAN the RIGHT-OF-WAY, especially when driving a hybrid or electric vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN turning AND a PEDESTRIAN using a guide dog or white cane is nearby, the DRIVER SHOULD be careful and give the PEDESTRIAN the RIGHT-OF-WAY, especially when driving a hybrid or electric vehicle.
rules.note: Blind pedestrians have the right-of-way at all times; reason given: they rely on sound, which hybrid and electric vehicles make little of.

rules.title: Never turn in front of light rail
rules.when: a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE is approaching
rules.action: turn in front of the LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE is approaching, the DRIVER MUST NOT turn in front of the LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE.
rules.note: The image shows a red car turning across the tracks into the path of a light rail vehicle as the wrong example.

rules.title: Turning across light rail tracks
rules.when: about to turn across light rail tracks
rules.action: check for approaching LIGHT RAIL VEHICLES and complete the turn only when the traffic light indicates the DRIVER may proceed
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn across light rail tracks, the DRIVER MUST check for approaching LIGHT RAIL VEHICLES and complete the turn only when the traffic light indicates the DRIVER may proceed.
rules.note: Light rail vehicles can interrupt traffic lights.

rules.title: Watch a large vehicle's turn signals
rules.when: following a large vehicle AND about to pass it
rules.action: look at the large vehicle's turn signals before starting to pass
rules.statement: WHEN following a large vehicle AND about to pass it, the DRIVER MUST look at the large vehicle's turn signals before starting to pass.
rules.note: Reason given: large vehicles often swing wide in the opposite direction in order to turn.

rules.title: No cutting in front of large vehicles to turn
rules.when: driving near a large vehicle or truck
rules.action: change lanes directly in front of it to reach an exit or turn
rules.statement: WHEN driving near a large vehicle or truck, the DRIVER MUST NOT change lanes directly in front of it to reach an exit or turn.

rules.title: Do not pass a left-turning driver on the left
rules.when: the driver ahead is signaling a left turn
rules.action: pass that vehicle on the left
rules.statement: WHEN the driver ahead is signaling a left turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass that vehicle on the left.

rules.title: Passing a left-turning driver on the right
rules.when: the driver ahead is turning left AND the DRIVER can safely pass on the right
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN the driver ahead is turning left AND the DRIVER can safely pass on the right, the DRIVER MAY pass on the right.
rules.note: 10.204: never drive off the paved or main-traveled part of the road to pass.

rules.title: Bike lane use when turning
rules.when: preparing to turn
rules.action: drive in a BIKE LANE within 200 feet of the INTERSECTION or turn
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive in a BIKE LANE within 200 feet of the INTERSECTION or turn.
rules.note: Driving in a bike lane is illegal except when parking, entering or leaving the road, or turning within 200 feet of an intersection; 13.119 says enter a bike lane no more than 200 feet before starting a turn.

rules.title: Check for cyclists before entering bike lane to turn
rules.when: entering a BIKE LANE to turn
rules.action: check the BLIND SPOTS for CYCLISTS and enter only when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN entering a BIKE LANE to turn, the DRIVER MUST check the BLIND SPOTS for CYCLISTS and enter only when it is safe.

rules.title: Merge behind a cyclist to turn
rules.when: preparing to make a turn AND a CYCLIST is in the path toward the turn
rules.action: merge safely behind the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to make a turn AND a CYCLIST is in the path toward the turn, the DRIVER MUST merge safely behind the CYCLIST.

rules.title: Cyclists turn like drivers
rules.when: making a left or right turn
rules.action: make the turn in the same way drivers do, using hand signals and turn lanes
rules.statement: WHEN making a left or right turn, the CYCLIST MUST make the turn in the same way drivers do, using hand signals and turn lanes.
rules.note: Diagrams show cyclists using the left lane to turn left and the right side of the road to turn right.

rules.title: Cyclists may use the left turn lane
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: use the left turn lane
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the CYCLIST MAY use the left turn lane.

rules.title: Cyclist shoulder check before turning
rules.when: about to turn
rules.action: look over the shoulder to make sure the lane is clear
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn, the CYCLIST MUST look over the shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.

rules.title: Cyclist may leave the right edge to turn
rules.when: traveling slower than the flow of traffic AND preparing to make a left turn OR approaching a right turn
rules.action: ride away from the right curb or edge of the road
rules.statement: WHEN traveling slower than the flow of traffic AND preparing to make a left turn OR approaching a right turn, the CYCLIST MAY ride away from the right curb or edge of the road.
rules.note: Exceptions to the requirement that slower cyclists ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge.

rules.title: Right turn at a multi-lane roundabout
rules.when: turning right at a ROUNDABOUT with multiple lanes
rules.action: choose the right lane and exit in the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning right at a ROUNDABOUT with multiple lanes, the DRIVER MUST choose the right lane and exit in the right lane.
rules.note: The image shows the yellow car entering and leaving in the right lane at the first exit.

rules.title: Left turn at a multi-lane roundabout
rules.when: turning left at a ROUNDABOUT with multiple lanes
rules.action: enter and continue driving counter-clockwise until reaching the exit in the chosen direction
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at a ROUNDABOUT with multiple lanes, the DRIVER MUST enter and continue driving counter-clockwise until reaching the exit in the chosen direction.
rules.note: The image shows the blue car entering in the left lane, circling on the inner lane and exiting to the left. Counter-clockwise travel comes from 12.108.

rules.title: Signal when exiting a roundabout
rules.when: changing lanes in OR exiting a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: signal
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes in OR exiting a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST signal.
